LanguageData.RK_Petro_RemoveGasPipe_NG_Desc: Drag to deconstruct pipes, valves, pumps and taps on the natural gas network. While selected the whole natural gas network lights up in orange so you can see the extent. Only marks for deconstruction — colonists still do the work.
LanguageData.RK_Petro_RemoveGasPipe_NH3_Desc: Drag to deconstruct pipes, valves, pumps and taps on the ammonia network. While selected the whole ammonia network lights up in magenta so you can see the extent. Only marks for deconstruction — colonists still do the work.
LanguageData.RK_Petro_RemoveGasPipe_Asphalt_Desc: Drag to deconstruct pipes, valves, pumps and taps on the asphalt network. While selected the whole asphalt network lights up in sky blue so you can see the extent. Only marks for deconstruction — colonists still do the work.
